thread:
Ashley (PM): quick check — post-launch tradeoff. We have a regression reported by 3 customers: embedding similarity drops ~12% on long docs (>30k chars). Support flags AcmeInc as P1. Do we pull a hotfix into next sprint or ship the planned QOL enhancements first? Need a decision today.

Ben (Eng): can you paste the repro details? is this model drift or runtime issue?

Deepa (Support): repro snippet from AcmeInc: "search result relevance degrades for long manuals, top1 often wrong". Seen for AcmeInc, NovaLabs, and one smaller PLG account over last 48h. Customers report: reproducible, not intermittent.

Carla (Eng-ML): looked at traces — it smells like KV-cache boundary eviction for long sequences; similarity vectors get truncated around token boundary which lowers sim score. Not model drift. Seems runtime/kv handling.

Evan (Design): QOL enhancements (search UI microcopy + result grouping) are high-visibility, but they won't fix core retrieval for enterprise customers.

Ashley (PM): okay — options: A) Hotfix (blocking, ~3 dev-days) in next sprint, delays QOL. B) Ship QOL first (customer visible, lower risk). C) Canary runtime patch for affected accounts then decide. Leaning C for least disruption.

Ben (Eng): technically we can gate a runtime flag and route only affected accounts to the canary. Low-risk path. Do we have SLO/monitoring for sim-quality?

Carla (Eng-ML): we can add a sim-quality check in the canary pipeline. Proposed quick patch (estimate): 3 dev-days + 1 infra day for canary routing and monitors. Patch change is small: adjust KV padding at sequence boundary. Example config: 

```
runtime:
  kv_cache:
    boundary_padding: 64
```

Ben (Eng): rollout plan I'd use: branch -> unit + sim regression tests -> build image -> deploy as canary for AcmeInc+NovaLabs via routing flag -> monitor p99 latency and sim-metric for 24h -> promote/rollback. Rollback steps are trivial (flip flag).

Deepa (Support): AcmeInc expects a timeline. They'll opt into canary if we notify them. NovaLabs also open to opt-in. I'll coordinate and draft comms.

Ashley (PM): decision: proceed with option C (canary). Ben/Carla, prioritize the patch; target canary by EOD Thursday. Deepa: notify AcmeInc/NovaLabs with opt-in instructions and SLA caveats. Evan: move QOL enhancements to next-next sprint and update roadmap. I'll update the sprint board and send a follow-up with owners.

Ben (Eng): ack. I'll open a ticket and tag @oncall for a 24h watch window.

jenkins-bot: deploy pipeline created: job/product/2150056789-hotfix-canary -> waiting for CI. :rocket:

Ashley (PM): thanks everyone — small focused win, try to keep scope tight. If sim-metric doesn't improve in canary, we reconvene and consider rolling a broader hotfix. :)
